{{#if: {{{load|}}}
	|{{#ifeq: {{Imagename|{{{1}}}}} | skip
		|[[{{{1}}}|link={{{3|}}}|{{#if:{{{4|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{3}}}}}]]
		|[[File:{{Imagename|{{{1}}}}}|{{{load|}}}px|link={{{3|}}}|{{#if:{{{4|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{3}}}}}]]
	}}
	|{{#if:{{{1|}}}
		|{{#ifeq: {{#sub:{{Imagename|{{{1}}}}}|0|4}} | skip
			|{{{1}}}
			|{{#ifexpr: {{#imgw:{{#explode:{{Imagename|{{{1}}}}}|caption:|0}}}} > 1500
				| [[File:{{#explode:{{Imagename|{{{1}}}}}|caption:|0}}|650px]]
				| {{#ifexpr: {{#imgw:{{#explode:{{Imagename|{{{1}}}}}|caption:|0}}}} > 1000
					| [[File:{{#explode:{{Imagename|{{{1}}}}}|caption:|0}}|500px]]
					| {{#ifexpr: {{#imgw:{{#explode:{{Imagename|{{{1}}}}}|caption:|0}}}} > 500
						| [[File:{{#explode:{{Imagename|{{{1}}}}}|caption:|0}}|400px]]
						| [[File:{{#explode:{{Imagename|{{{1}}}}}|caption:|0}}]]
					}}
				}}
			}}{{#if: {{#explode:{{Imagename|{{{1}}}}}|caption:|1}}
				|<br>{{#explode:{{Imagename|{{{1}}}}}|caption:|1}}
				|
			}}
		}}
		|
	}}
}}<noinclude>

This template limits the max width of an infobox image. It is built into infoboxes.

[[Category:Infobox utility templates]]
</noinclude>
